name: kunalssachdeva.github.io (Hugo)
install: HUGO_VERSION=0.164.0; if command -v hugo >/dev/null 2>&1 && hugo version | grep -q "v${HUGO_VERSION}.*extended"; then echo "Hugo extended ${HUGO_VERSION} already installed; skipping."; else tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && wget -qO "${tmp}/hugo.tar.gz" "https://github.com/gohugoio/hugo/releases/download/v${HUGO_VERSION}/hugo_extended_${HUGO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" && sudo tar -C /usr/local/bin -xzf "${tmp}/hugo.tar.gz" hugo && rm -rf "${tmp}"; fi && hugo version
